ei.title: When Loss Becomes Joy: A Change in View
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Marilyn and her three-year-old daughter, Sarah, took a trip to the beach, where Sarah built her first sandcastle. Moments later, an enormous wave destroyed Sarah's castle. In response to the loss of her sandcastle, tears streamed down Sarah's cheeks and her heart was broken. She ran to Marilyn, saying she would never build a sandcastle again. Marilyn said, "Part of the joy of building a sandcastle is that, in the end, we give it as a gift to the ocean." Sarah loved this idea and responded with enthusiasm to the idea of building another castle—this time, even closer to the water so the ocean would get its gift sooner!

questions.passage: Marilyn and her three-year-old daughter, Sarah, took a trip to the beach, where Sarah built her first sandcastle. Moments later, an (A)[tiny / enormous] wave (B)[protected / destroyed] Sarah's castle. In response to the loss of her sandcastle, tears streamed down Sarah's cheeks and her heart was broken. She ran to Marilyn, saying she would never build a sandcastle again. Marilyn said, "Part of the (C)[joy / sorrow] of building a sandcastle is that, in the end, we give it as a gift to the ocean." Sarah loved this idea and responded with enthusiasm to the idea of building another castle—this time, even closer to the water so the ocean would get its gift sooner!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① enormous — destroyed — joy: 원문 일치. 거대한(enormous) 파도가 성을 무너뜨리고(destroyed), 모래성을 쌓는 기쁨(joy)을 이야기하는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② tiny — destroyed — joy: (A) tiny(작은)는 성을 무너뜨린 거대한(enormous) 파도와 모순
❌ ③ enormous — protected — joy: (B) protected(보호했다)는 파도가 성을 무너뜨린(destroyed) 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ enormous — destroyed — sorrow: (C) sorrow(슬픔)는 모래성을 쌓는 기쁨(joy)과 반대
det.tip: an enormous wave(거대한 파도) / destroyed the castle(무너뜨림) / the joy of building(쌓는 기쁨)

questions.passage: Marilyn and her three-year-old daughter, Sarah, took a trip to the beach, where Sarah built her first sandcastle. Moments later, an enormous wave destroyed Sarah's castle. In response to the (A)[recovery / loss] of her sandcastle, tears streamed down Sarah's cheeks and her heart was (B)[mended / broken]. She ran to Marilyn, saying she would never build a sandcastle again. Marilyn said, "Part of the joy of building a sandcastle is that, in the end, we give it as a gift to the ocean." Sarah loved this idea and responded with (C)[enthusiasm / reluctance] to the idea of building another castle—this time, even closer to the water so the ocean would get its gift sooner!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① recovery — broken — enthusiasm: (A) recovery(되찾음)는 모래성을 잃은(loss) 맥락과 반대
✅ ② loss — broken — enthusiasm: 원문 일치. 모래성의 상실(loss)에 마음이 무너지고(broken), 나중엔 열정(enthusiasm)으로 반응한 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ loss — mended — enthusiasm: (B) mended(고쳐진)는 마음이 무너진(broken) 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ loss — broken — reluctance: (C) reluctance(꺼림)는 또 쌓자는 생각을 좋아한(enthusiasm) 맥락과 모순
det.tip: the loss of her sandcastle(상실) / heart was broken(상심) / responded with enthusiasm(열정)

questions.passage: Marilyn and her three-year-old daughter, Sarah, took a trip to the beach, where Sarah built her first sandcastle. Moments later, an enormous wave destroyed Sarah's castle. In response to the loss of her sandcastle, tears (A)[dried / streamed] down Sarah's cheeks and her heart was broken. She ran to Marilyn, saying she would never build a sandcastle again. Marilyn said, "Part of the joy of building a sandcastle is that, in the end, we give it as a gift to the ocean." Sarah loved this idea and (B)[ignored / responded] with enthusiasm to the idea of building another castle—this time, even (C)[closer / farther] to the water so the ocean would get its gift sooner!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① dried — responded — closer: (A) dried(말랐다)는 눈물이 뺨을 타고 흘러내린(streamed) 맥락과 반대
❌ ② streamed — ignored — closer: (B) ignored(무시했다)는 또 쌓자는 생각에 열정적으로 반응한(responded) 맥락과 반대
✅ ③ streamed — responded — closer: 원문 일치. 눈물이 흘러내리고(streamed), 열정적으로 반응하며(responded), 물에 더 가까이(closer) 쌓자는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ streamed — responded — farther: (C) farther(더 먼)는 바다가 선물을 더 빨리 받도록 '더 가까이(closer)'라는 맥락과 모순
det.tip: tears streamed down(흘러내림) / responded with enthusiasm(반응함) / even closer to the water(더 가까이)

det.korean: ② protected(보호했다) → destroyed(파괴했다): 파도가 모래성을 무너뜨린 맥락

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 wave의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) (손을) 흔들다 — (B) 파도: (A)는 작별 인사로 손을 '흔들다'(동사), (B)는 성을 무너뜨린 '파도'(명사)로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ② (A) 물결치다 — (B) 손짓: (A)는 손을 흔드는 것이지 물결치는 것이 아님
❌ ③ (A) (손을) 흔들다 — (B) 전파: (B)의 wave는 전파가 아니라 바다의 파도
❌ ④ (A) 파도 — (B) (손을) 흔들다: (A)는 '흔들다', (B)는 '파도'로 뒤바뀜
det.tip: wave: ① (동사) (손을) 흔들다 ② (명사) 파도 ③ (명사) 전파/물결

✅ ④ ocean: ocean(대양/바다)은 지구의 대부분을 덮고 있는 아주 넓은 소금물 지역이라는 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답

questions.passage: Marilyn and her three-year-old daughter, Sarah, took a trip to the beach, where Sarah __________ (build) her first sandcastle. Moments later, an enormous wave destroyed Sarah's castle.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 관계부사 where가 이끄는 절로, 주절의 동사 took(과거)와 시제를 일치시켜야 한다. build의 과거형은 불규칙 변화로 built. where Sarah built her first sandcastle(그곳에서 Sarah가 첫 모래성을 쌓았다)

questions.passage: Marilyn and her three-year-old daughter, Sarah, took a trip to the beach, where Sarah built her first sandcastle. Moments later, an enormous wave destroyed Sarah's castle. In response to the loss of her sandcastle, tears streamed down Sarah's cheeks and her __________. She ran to Marilyn, saying she would never build a sandcastle again. Marilyn said, "Part of the joy of building a sandcastle is that, in the end, we give it as a gift to the ocean." Sarah loved this idea and responded with enthusiasm to the idea of building another castle—this time, even closer to the water so the ocean would get its gift sooner!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: heart was broken=마음이 무너졌다 — 모래성을 잃고 눈물을 흘리며 상심한 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① heart was broken: 원문 'tears streamed down Sarah's cheeks and her heart was broken' 일치. 모래성을 잃고 눈물을 흘리며 상심한 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② face lit up(얼굴이 밝아졌다): 눈물을 흘리는 슬픈 상황과 모순
❌ ③ eyes shone(눈이 빛났다): 상심한 맥락과 반대
❌ ④ mind was clear(마음이 맑았다): 무너진 심정과 어울리지 않음
det.tip: one's heart was broken = 마음이 무너졌다, 상심했다

questions.passage: Marilyn and her three-year-old daughter, Sarah, __________ to the beach, where Sarah built her first sandcastle. Moments later, an enormous wave destroyed Sarah's castle. In response to the loss of her sandcastle, tears streamed down Sarah's cheeks and her heart was broken. She ran to Marilyn, saying she would never build a sandcastle again. Marilyn said, "Part of the joy of building a sandcastle is that, in the end, we give it as a gift to the ocean." Sarah loved this idea and responded with enthusiasm to the idea of building another castle—this time, even closer to the water so the ocean would get its gift sooner!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: took a trip=여행을 떠났다 — 모녀가 해변으로 여행을 떠난 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① took a trip: 원문 'Marilyn and her ... daughter ... took a trip to the beach' 일치. 모녀가 해변으로 여행을 떠난 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② gave up hope(희망을 버렸다): 여행을 떠나는 맥락과 무관
❌ ③ broke down(고장났다/무너졌다): 문맥과 다름
❌ ④ turned back(되돌아갔다): 해변으로 떠나는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: take a trip to ~ = ~로 여행을 떠나다
